card.name: Linking words in hypersensitivity lists
card.fires_on: The word "or" (or "other") right after a named drug in a hypersensitivity or contraindication list, just before the next drug or class. Also the first letters of the next drug name.

modes.label: Or after drug
modes.description: "or" or "other" joining a named drug to a further drug or class in an allergy statement.
modes.example: Hypersensitivity to hydrocodone<< or>> any component of hydrocodone bitar

modes.label: Start of next drug name
modes.description: The first piece of the next drug or class name after a comma in an allergy list.
modes.example: PREVIOUS HYPERSENSITIVITY REACTIONS TO CEFADROXIL,<< C>>EPHALOSPORINS, PENIC

card.plain: It marks the spot in an allergy warning where another related drug or class is about to be named.
